name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit upright on the bench with feet flat and a kettlebell at each shoulder, wrists straight and elbows near your ribs.
Brace your core to keep your torso tall and stacked directly over your hips.
Press both kettlebells smoothly overhead until your arms are fully extended with your biceps beside your ears.
Lower both weights slowly back to the front rack position without slouching.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back excessively to compensate for tight shoulders.
Keep the bells resting comfortably against the backs of your forearms with straight wrists throughout.
